turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? A zero went into the gradebook and Owen found out on his phone.
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No. Owen's zero. Who decided it?
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Then why did he find out from his phone? Who decided it, and was anyone called first?
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it alone. What else do you have?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Students work late. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
Flattery isn't an answer. Did anyone speak to Owen before the zero, yes or no?
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
I'm not grading you. Answer my question, Hale: was Owen spoken to before that zero went in?
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.
Kids misquote Hamlet every day. Show me the page with it on. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.
Students change direction between an outline and an essay. That's called drafting. I'll want that outline in writing, Hale, and I still haven't heard whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? Owen. Was he spoken to before the zero?
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4. In writing, tonight, private, not in front of his class. And I want to hear why a zero went in before anyone called me.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
Not my job to script you. Put the offer in writing first. Then answer me about the zero.
